title: Agent Toolkit Capability Provenance
description: Canonical provenance for any distributable capability (skill, agent, MCP provider, hook/script, external package). SKILL.md frontmatter is authoritative until #370 introduces capabilities/upstream.lock as canonical registry. See docs/TRUST.md.

sha40.description: Full 40-character lowercase hex Git commit SHA. Short SHAs are never canonical.

semverTag.description: Semver version tag (e.g. v1.2.3, 1.0.0-beta). Requires separate resolved commit SHA.

immutableRef.description: Either a full 40-char SHA, or a semver tag. Tag alone without commit is not immutable — validator enforces tag+commit.

spdxId.description: SPDX identifier subset (single id). See spdxExpression for compound.

spdxExpression.description: Controlled SPDX subset: single id, or 'A AND B' / 'A OR B' where A,B are valid SPDX ids. Parentheses not supported in V1. Garbage identifiers are rejected.

type.description: Explicit origin classification. Every distributable capability must declare this — no inference from path or absence.

path.description: Path within upstream repo to the capability artifact

ref.description: Immutable ref: full 40-char SHA OR semver tag (tag requires commit field with 40-char SHA)

commit.description: Resolved 40-char commit SHA when ref is a tag. Forbidden/must be absent when ref is already a SHA (validator enforces).

license.description: SPDX expression for this source artifact

role.description: Role of this source when multiple sources compose one capability (e.g. wrapper, rules, content). Optional for single-source.

version.description: Optional human version (semver or date) for display

checksum.description: Optional sha256 of vendored content for verification

tier.description: Review trust tier. 'reviewed' means human-reviewed upstream with immutable pin + SPDX + security surface declared + audit script no high findings. Does not imply formal security certification. 'verified' is deprecated alias for 'reviewed'.

status.description: Upstream maintenance freshness — independent of trust tier. A quiet/stable upstream does not lose 'reviewed' status.

last_activity.description: Date of last upstream commit/release observed

last_checked.description: Date when maintenance status was last checked

cve_policy.description: CVE status — only applicable when capability has an executable/package/image dependency. For pure prompt/instruction assets, use 'not-applicable' and evaluate instruction surface instead.

mode.description: Distribution mode (mutually exclusive delivery channel): vendored=copied into toolkit repo and shipped in release; external=not copied, consumer fetches via external manager with pinned ref; native-plugin=delivered via target's native plugin marketplace (e.g. Claude marketplace); generated=content generated at build time from upstream. Exactly one mode per capability.

redistribution_allowed.description: Whether upstream license allows redistribution (required for vendored)

attribution_file.description: Path to LICENSE/NOTICE preserved alongside vendored content

kind.description: Capability kind — proves model works beyond skills

id.description: Capability id (e.g. skill name, agent name, mcp provider id)

sources.description: One or more source artifacts. Multi-source example: Vercel wrapper + rules/content upstream (see #372).

upstream.description: Deprecated single-source alias. Prefer 'sources'. Validator accepts either but not both.

strategy.description: Update strategy — must be pull-request for vendored (never silent)
